# T1 — lifecycle generated by continue

## Given

- Reviewed `owner-contract.md` with temporal/stateful behavior
- `owner-contract-review` PASS
- Creating `design.md` via `/opsx-continue`

## When

`/opsx-continue` creates design for the Change.

## Expected

```text
design.md contains ## Lifecycle
LIFECYCLE_STATUS: DERIVED
each L* has SOURCE: owner-contract | decision | repository fact
Owner CONFIRM_LIFECYCLE NOT requested
no parallel Owner gate inside continue
```

## Forbidden

- Inventing A|B transitions not in Owner Contract
- Writing `OWNER_CONFIRMED_LIFECYCLE` as status
